title: Why Two Versions of a Document Can Confuse AI
reader_task: Keep conflicting versions of a document from confusing an AI: find the differing facts, preserve dates and provenance in the text, separate superseded from scoped sources, resolve ambiguity without inventing precedence, remove stale excerpts and test answers.
scope_exclusions: Not a generic RAG, hallucination or deduplication guide (E05)
Provenance fields, scoped passages and packet updates in depth belong to M12-S1, S2, S3
No legal interpretation; fictional policies only
description: Conflicting document versions confuse AI when dates and provenance get lost. See how it happens in conversion, and how to label, choose and test the right source.
description_change: Rewritten around the observed loss of dates; contains 'conflicting document versions' and AI; 165 characters.
excerpt: Two versions of a policy, nearly identical, with different deadlines. After conversion, nothing said which one was current. Here's how to keep that from reaching a model.
author: DevBehindYou
